title: Bullying Incident Information Sheet
subtitle: Capture reported conduct, exact statement, location pattern, and protective step; confirm retaliation concern and support follow-up.
description: Bullying Incident records reported conduct, exact statement, location pattern, protective step, retaliation concern, and support follow-up. Bullying Incident evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this bullying incident controlled information handoff when staff must document reported conduct and exact statement. Reconcile location pattern, protective step, retaliation concern, and support follow-up before the bullying incident handoff. Preserve the original report, dated witness accounts, location map or digital-channel reference, protective-action log, retaliation check, and restricted support record. Ask the assigned bullying incident reviewer to confirm reported conduct against the organization's policy.
